طَمْثٌ Blood: (Fr, TA: [the context in the TA seems to indicate that it means blood that flows when a woman, or girl, is devirginated:] or the blood of the menses; (KL, and TA in art. جزر;) as also ↓ طِمْثٌ . (KL.) ―
-b2- And Dirt, filth, or pollution. (K.) ―
-b3- And A thing that induces suspicion, or evil opinion: one says, مَا بِفُلَانٍ طَمْثٌ There is not, in such a one, anything that induces suspicion, or evil opinion. (TA.) ―
-b4- And Corruption. (L, K; but not in the CK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
